title: cayratia wrayi
intro: Cayratia wrayi, commonly known as the Indian creeping vine or five-angle vine, is a plant species in the Vitaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and various other health issues. The health benefits of Cayratia wrayi include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and pain, and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of Cayratia wrayi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
